source_image.prompt: Photorealistic industrial product photograph for accurate 3D reconstruction. One complete Brazilian heavy rigid box truck, European cab-over design inspired by a modern Scania R or Volvo FH, THREE AXLES total, two rear axles with dual tires. A rigid straight chassis with a large rectangular refrigerated aluminum cargo box directly behind the cab, not a tractor with a separate trailer. Realistic Brazilian commercial vehicle proportions: overall length about 9 meters, width 2.5 meters, cab height 3.5 meters. Entire vehicle including every bumper, mirror, roof, box and all wheels fully inside frame with generous empty margin. Front three-quarter view, truck nose toward the right, camera at about 1.6 meters height, 50 mm product lens. Clear separation of cab, cargo box, black chassis, treaded rubber tires and metallic rims. Accurate headlights, windshield wipers, black grille, side mirrors, door seams, handles, access steps, mudguards, fuel tank, underbody axles and Brazilian license plate. Clean unbranded vehicle without text or logos. Plain uniform very light gray seamless studio background and ground, soft neutral studio illumination, barely visible contact shadow only, no environment, no scenery, no people. Sharp focus over the entire vehicle, realistic photographic materials, subtle wear, no illustration, no toy, no stylization, no lens flare. Cab painted rich deep navy blue with realistic automotive metallic finish; silver corrugated aluminum refrigerated box; utilitarian work truck, clean but a little road dust on tires.

compatibility_changes: Python 3.11 used because upstream pinned binary packages lack Python 3.12 wheels
ONNX updated to avoid executable-stack failure on host Linux
Shape components mapping and execution device supplied for Accelerate offload
Paint VAE inputs and learned text embeddings moved to execution device
DINO offloaded independently; VAE sliced/tiled; RealESRGAN tiles 256px
Setuptools 80.9 retains pkg_resources for old Lightning; torchvision import redirected to current functional module

adaptations: Metallic multiplier 0.65, preserve generated texture maps
Embed local convex-hull support vertices for efficient exact contact
Uniform runtime fit into existing simulation envelope; front +X
Runtime spatial partition of the monolithic shell into cab/chassis, cargo box and six textured wheel meshes; all 160000 source triangles retained

limitations: Single image: hidden surfaces and mechanical details are inferred
Fine geometry and generated textures have reconstruction artifacts
Wheel segmentation uses calibrated spatial cuts; it is not a CAD rig and the reconstructed tyres are slightly irregular
